cotton cloud bank occluding the peak bases

cotton cloud-bank base hiding the peak/ground seam

notes: Source is a 192x192 web render with the squircle baked in as alpha-transparent corners (a=0), not the 1024 master; region hex reliable, sub-pixel edge/specular/shadow treatments estimated from a 4x upscale.
